component: Account Hub add-on notification control flow

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The add-on catch passes its Error into showNotification, but the checked branch then calls stopLoading and shows account-hub-success-addon without an early return or success-only branch. The header clears the previous notification before showing a new one. This exposes a source path where an install failure notification is followed by success; it does not establish visible timing, a reproduced install failure or that this historical patch introduced the order. The separate incomplete-config path uses warning rather than error, and raw-description concatenation guards optional error.message consistently. No runtime or test executed these caller sequences.
title: The checked add-on notification caller passes its error but still reaches an unconditional success notification
